title: 第3章 气运之子的东西没那么好抢第4章 气运之女楚玉璃
slug: 我气运之子反派系统什么鬼
content_zh:
“这是……纯阳圣体！”
炎曦美眸圆睁，震惊不已。
“没错。”
“你、你……这是哪里来的？”
炎曦声音略微颤抖，有些语无伦次。
她清楚记得。
墨羽之前没有任何特殊体质。
墨羽故作沉吟。
“我也不知道，一醒来就有，可能是……双修来的？”
炎曦愣在原地。
许久，才回过神来。
幽幽一叹。
“妖孽。”
她在上界纵横多年。
从未听闻双修可以获得体质。
体质，要么天生，要么耗费海量资源锻造。
而墨羽竟然通过双修获得了纯阳圣体。
这简直是他妈的见鬼了。
随即，她面露喜色。
“纯阳圣体自带纯阳真火，你快用它升级大焚天诀！”

墨羽点头。
大焚天诀是炎曦给他的。
类似焚诀，吸火变强。
无品阶功法。
此界功法分天地人三阶，每阶又分上中下三品。
他盘膝而坐，凝神静气，运转功法，开始提升大焚天诀。
体内，纯阳真火熊熊燃烧，宛如一条咆哮的火龙，在经脉中肆意奔腾。
砰！
一声闷响，墨羽体内气息暴涨。
金丹表面开始出现细微裂纹，仿佛有一个生命即将破壳而出。
修为直接从金丹四层飙升至金丹七层，连破三级。
大焚天诀也成功晋升，达到地阶中品！幽冥鬼火少了灵魂的强化，现在还不适合用来强化大焚天诀。
“不错。”
炎曦微微点头，眼中满是赞赏。
墨羽起身，一步踏出。
“外面那几个菜鸟，应该也等急了。”
……
狼头山脉，山风呼啸。
阴森的矿洞前。
content_en:
"This is... the Pure Yang Holy Body!"
Yan Xi's beautiful eyes widened in shock.
"That's right."
"You, you...where did this come from?"
Yan Xi's voice trembled slightly and was a little incoherent.
She remembered it clearly.
Mo Yu didn't have any special physique before.
Mo Yu pretended to be in deep thought.
"I don't know. It's there as soon as I wake up. Maybe it's... dual cultivators?"
Yan Xi froze on the spot.
It took a long time before he came back to his senses.
A faint sigh.
"Monster."
She has been in the upper world for many years.
I have never heard that you can gain physical fitness through dual cultivation.
Physique is either born or forged by consuming massive resources.
And Mo Yu actually obtained the Pure Yang Holy Body through dual cultivation.
This is fucking hell.
Immediately, her face lit up.
"The Holy Body of Pure Yang comes with the True Fire of Pure Yang, please use it to upgrade the Great Burning Heaven Technique!"
Mo Yu nodded.
The Great Burning Heaven Technique was given to him by Yan Xi.
Similar to Burn Jue, it absorbs fire and becomes stronger.
No grade skills.
The skills in this realm are divided into three levels: heaven, earth, and human beings, and each level is divided into three levels: upper, middle, and lower.
He sat cross-legged, concentrated his energy, activated his skills, and began to improve the Great Burning Heaven Technique.
Within the body, the pure Yang true fire burned blazingly, like a roaring fire dragon, running wildly through the meridians.
Bang!
There was a muffled sound, and the aura in Mo Yu's body surged.
Fine cracks began to appear on the surface of the golden elixir, as if a life was about to break out of its shell.
The cultivation level soared directly from the fourth level of Jindan to the seventh level of Jindan, breaking through three levels in a row.
The Great Burning Heaven Technique was also successfully promoted to the middle level of the earth level! The ghost fire of the underworld lacks the strengthening of the soul, so it is not suitable to be used to strengthen the Great Burning Heaven Technique.
"Not bad."
Yan Xi nodded slightly, his eyes full of appreciation.
Mo Yu stood up and took one step forward.
"Those rookies outside should be waiting impatiently."
…
In the Langtou Mountains, the mountain wind howls.
In front of the eerie mine.
